summary: Frontend-only test of Merchant Analytics mobile page (412x900). Logged in as Sharma Electricals via OTP, navigated to /merchant/analytics. Header/hero, range label, all 4 preset switches (today/7d/30d/month/custom) fire correct GET /merchant/analytics?date_from=...&date_to=... requests, KPI cards (earning ₹358, customer ₹123, partner ₹235, avg ₹11.93) render in ₹-compact format matching API. AreaTrend, StackedBars and Donut all render, tap tooltips work (Commission / Customer+Partner / donut slice). Custom range: RangeCalendar with 30 day cells, cal-prev/cal-next exist, picking two dates enables custom-apply which reloads data; custom-close hides box and resets preset to 30 Days (label restored). Regression: /merchant/bankkyc and /wallet render correctly.

console_warnings.issue: Console warnings still present on /merchant/analytics: `Unknown event handler property onStartShouldSetResponder` (also onResponderTerminationRequest, onResponderGrant, onResponderMove, onResponderRelease, onResponderTerminate). The task asked to confirm this was fixed after removing Path onPress. It is not fully fixed — RN Pressable responder props are leaking to DOM/SVG children on web. Not a functional blocker but user asked to confirm gone.

action_items: Investigate remaining onStartShouldSetResponder / onResponder* warnings on Analytics page. Likely originates from Pressable wrapping <Svg> (react-native-svg on web) or from a nested touchable in charts. Consider replacing outer Pressable with a plain View + onClick via web-only wrapper, or using react-native-svg's built-in touch props filter.
critical_code_review_comments: AnalyticsCharts.tsx: xTickIdx uses `every = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(50/step))` even though comment mentions minTickGap=20; slight inconsistency but visually fine.

analytics.tsx custom-apply calls `load` which uses the memoised `range`. Because `range` derives from `custom` state, this works, but on the very first apply React may batch — currently OK since setCustom sync updates before onPress. Verified by end-to-end network capture (custom apply fires the correct date_from/date_to).

Custom-close resets preset to 30d but does NOT clear `custom.from/to`. If user reopens range-custom, the previously picked dates remain highlighted. Minor UX nit — the web reference behaves the same, so acceptable.
KPI tile uses `boxShadow` string which works only on web; on native it would need shadowOpacity/elevation. Fine since this is expo-web target.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Analytics mobile port fully working. Only leftover: RN responder-prop console warnings on the /merchant/analytics route. Reproduce by logging in as merchant, opening /merchant/analytics, inspecting devtools console for `Unknown event handler property onStartShouldSetResponder`.
rca of the issue: Pressable from react-native (rendered on web via RNW) exposes responder handler props (onStartShouldSetResponder, onResponderGrant/Move/Release/Terminate/TerminationRequest). When these props are forwarded to a child SVG element from react-native-svg on web, React DOM logs `Unknown event handler property` warnings because <svg> DOM node doesn't recognise them. Mitigation: wrap Svg inside a plain View so Pressable receives responder events only on the wrapping View, or filter props in the chart components before spreading.
